name: 48529 · Burton, MI
findings: ZIP 48529 (Burton) has 29 nonprofit organizations. 8 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48529 (Burton) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48529 (Burton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 35% of the typical level).
